Spoiler: ||hidden text|| in a paragraph.

Highlight: ==marked== and insert: ++inserted++.

Superscript: x^2^ and subscript: H~2~O.

Underline: _underlined_ when the flag is on.

Inline math $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$ and display math:

$$
\int_0^1 x^2 dx
$$
